q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of PVA adhesive or white glue?
title: PVA adhesive carbon footprint per kg
short: Weigh the monomers, polymer emulsion, water, fillers and additives per kg of adhesive and multiply each by its supplier's figure. Add reactor heating, stirring and filling energy, divided by kg produced, and the containers.
audience: Adhesive makers for wood, paper and packaging

ul: Vinyl acetate monomer or bought PVA emulsion.
Emulsion polymerisation reactor with steam or thermic heating.

p: Report per kg of adhesive at its solids content, since a 50% solids glue and a 35% solids glue are not equal.

example.title: Worked example: adhesive plant per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 31,550 / 300,000 = 0.105 kg CO2 per kg
Add monomers, fillers and containers for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
